Fine-mapping Type 2 Diabetes Loci to Single-Variant Resolution Using High-Density Imputation and Islet-Specific Epigenome Maps.
Mahajan A, et al.
Nat Genet 2018 Nov;50(11):1505-1513. doi: 10.1038/s41588-018-0241-6.

dataTableLegendHtml:
Click on a column header to sort the table by that column. Mouse over column headers to see tooltips. Filter the table using the filters above:

  • enter a threshold value or full or partial text string and hit Return
  • make a selection from the drop-down menus

Multiple filters may be combined.

Click the View button in a row to see more data.
